init_modal_sandbox: create a Modal sandbox from a ModalConfig with optional tunnel support and return the sandbox and tools
ModalBackend_NoTunnel: build a tunnel-free Modal backend that runs bash commands in a sandbox via sandbox.exec and client_cli
ModalBackend_Tunnel: build a tunnel-based Modal backend that communicates with a sandbox server over an encrypted TCP tunnel
ModalBackend_run_bash: run a bash command inside the Modal sandbox and return a BashResult with exit code and output
ModalConfig: create a frozen ModalConfig dataclass to configure image URL, session timeout, CPU, memory, and plugin settings
